about: Confirmation set for the window search: 5 CaptainCook4D recordings from three recipes no earlier set uses (pinwheels, zoodles, butter corn cup). Picked and label-checked after the search was frozen, committed with it, then run once. Labels checked by eye with proofstep.datasets.label_sheets.

recordings.notes: Jelly only, no nut butter; the roll is sliced with a knife, so the floss steps are skipped.
Sliced with a knife at the end; the floss is barely used.
